what: VENDORED, BYTE-IDENTICAL, from the osint-graph repo. Do not edit these files here — edit them there and re-vendor, or the two copies drift and the map plane and the graph plane start disagreeing about what a defect is.
source_commit: 8dd4515 + uncommitted ledger-elevation edits to serving/export_map.py and the new serving/routability.py (2026-09-02); graph_api.py and build_serving_snapshot.py were NOT re-vendored and their hashes above still describe 7a555ef
layout_note: The directory names `serving/` and `loader/` are NOT decoration: export_map.py computes its sibling loader path from __file__, so mirroring the source layout is what lets these files be copied without a single edit.
⚠️ this seal went stale once: Commit ce882f5 re-vendored graph_api.py and added build_serving_snapshot.py without updating this file, so the manifest asserted the PRE-FIX hash for the one file that work order changed and omitted the new file entirely — an integrity check would have reported a false mismatch on exactly the thing being verified. Re-vendoring MUST rewrite this file in the same commit.
2026-09-02 ledger elevation: export_map.py gained `type` on every entity row, `seed_type`, `detail_rest`, and the routability census (manifest.routability / manifest.unroutable_types) backed by the new routability.py; re-vendored byte-identical to BOTH map-service/serving and Scope/api/osint_map/serving. The page serving/osint-map-v1.html in the source repo was ALSO synced back to map-service/static/osint_map.html, because the census reads the route table out of the page and the two copies had drifted (the source copy predated the county picker and carried no SRC_TAG table).
